# openinfra_flow_log (Resource)

VPC-style flow logging via OVS sFlow -> a node-local collector -> Loki (kube-ovn) — the AWS VPC Flow Logs. Per-bridge (per-node), sampled; scope to a VPC by filtering records on CIDR in Loki. Requires the kube-ovn CNI.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Resource name. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `collector_namespace` (String) Namespace for the collector DaemonSet (the XRD's spec.namespace).
- `namespace` (String) Kubernetes namespace. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `node_selector` (Map of String) Which nodes to capture on (label key -> value). Omit for all nodes.
- `sampling_rate` (Number) 1:N packet sampling. 64 is a sane default; 1 samples every packet (debug only).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `namespace/name`, the import identifier.
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the resource's Ready condition is True. Terraform returns as soon as the object is accepted, so this is usually `false` immediately after apply — the platform reconciles asynchronously.
